description: Land Title Settlement Department - Homagama, Homagama D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520001
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land and property matters, specifically calling for claims to intestate property (property of deceased persons without wills) under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed land descriptions including cadastral map numbers, parcel numbers, land extents, and registration details. The content focuses on land title settlement and property registration processes, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
